name: 4-Deck Waveform
description:
2 DECK, 2/4 DECK and 4 DECK layouts with native waveforms.
Native Height 30 is recommended for four decks.

name: Side Screen Browser
description:
Hold a Deck Select button 1 second to open or close.
USB > Playlists > Tracks. Beat Loop: turn to scroll, press
to open or confirm, hold to go back. LOAD LOCK required.

name: Quick USB Access
description:
Named, coloured USB shortcuts above the waveforms.
Tap a drive to open its native browser. No track is loaded.

name: Light Theme
description:
Light backgrounds with dark text. Original or Blue/Gray
waveform palette. Disable to restore the stock dark theme.

name: Smooth Waveforms
description:
Native Height 30 is the recommended four-deck mode.
Other modes are available for comparison. No audio changes.
Disabling restores Stock timing.

name: FX Frequency
description:
LOW, ALL or HIGH chooses the filter-assisted FX range.
Enable Beat FX Sidebar to show the on-screen controls.
The physical Beat FX ON button still engages the effect.

name: Beat FX Sidebar
description:
Native effect name, BPM, beat and time at the right.
Required for FX Frequency and Gate Cues quick controls.
Yields to native popup screens in every waveform layout.

name: FX Target Knob
description:
TIME selects MIC / 3 / 1 / 2 / 4 / MASTER.
Hold either deck's SHIFT to adjust effect time instead.
FX SELECT retains its normal function.

name: Slip Mode
description:
Swap each physical SLIP REVERSE button for forward Slip.
The button toggles Slip per deck; LEDs show its state.
Disable to restore the stock SLIP REVERSE function.

name: Hide Track Names
description:
Eye controls on the 2 DECK overviews hide title and artist
on the main and side screens. Tap again to reveal them.

name: Zone Continuous Play
description:
The deck assigned to ZONE on channel 3 or 4 continues
to its playlist's next track. Other decks are unchanged.

name: Stems
description:
Per-deck VOCAL, INST, BASS and DRUMS controls.
Needs compatible pre-generated stem files on the USB.
USB-owned decoder, audio processing and touch controls.

name: Playlist Editing
description:
Reorder tracks in USB playlists using main Browse.
This writes the library; keep a separate USB backup.
A per-boot backup is made before the first save.

name: Side Screen Now Playing (Legacy)
description:
Legacy side-screen now-playing view.
Requires Side Screen Browser. TYTO is the preferred view.

name: FPS Overlay
description:
Measured native waveform repaint rate, not LCD scanout.
A diagnostic aid; it does not change frame timing.
